channel.title: New Jersey Monitor - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Jersey Monitor (newjerseymonitor.com)

item.title: NJ Legislature approves trio of immigration bills in divided votes
item.description: Democrats said the bills would protect immigrants from the president’s mass deportation effort. Republicans said they prioritize politics over public safety.

item.title: Airport chaos: TSA agents skip work, security lines expand, Trump sends in ICE to assist
item.description: Airport security workers missed work Monday at the highest rate since a partial government shutdown began in mid-February, the Department of Homeland Security said.

item.title: US Senate confirms Mullin as next Homeland Security boss
item.description: The U.S. Senate voted Monday evening to confirm Markwayne Mullin to lead the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: NJ state police sued for keeping retired cops’ gun carry permits a secret
item.description: A gun rights advocate says the state's refusal to release data on retired cops with carry permits guns hides the true scope of gun carry in New Jersey.

item.title: Lawsuit alleges Assembly speaker’s law firm violated family leave law
item.description: A former paralegal at Assembly Speaker Craig Coughlin’s law firm alleges she was fired for requesting family leave to care for a loved one.

item.title: US Senate turns down photo ID requirement for voting, slammed by Dems as ‘theatrics’
item.description: The U.S. Senate was unable to agree Thursday whether to require photo identification to vote in federal elections.

item.title: ‘Because I’m president’: Trump explains why he voted by mail yet opposes voting by mail
item.description: President Trump, who wants to ban mail-in voting, said he had the right to vote by mail-in ballot in Florida’s special election “because I’m president of the United States.”

item.title: Your personal data might set your grocery prices. States aim to crack down.
item.description: With many Americans struggling to afford the basics, consumers and lawmakers are becoming more concerned about how retailers use algorithms to price products.

item.title: Cherry Hill school district targets citizen with ludicrous lawsuit over public records
item.description: The Cherry Hill school district is suing journalist Ben Shore, alleging that he has filed numerous and “vexatious” public records requests with the district.

item.title: US Senate, House pass dueling Homeland Security bills, keeping department unfunded
item.description: The House of Representatives will not even consider a U.S. Senate-passed funding bill for the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: No Kings day rallies roll out across the US, with millions said to attend anti-Trump protests
item.description: Large crowds gathered Saturday in the nation's capital for the third No Kings protest, rallying against what organizers say is an unprecedented expansion of power by President Trump.

item.title: Thousands in NJ protest President Trump in ‘No Kings’ rallies
item.description: Thousands protested the Trump administration at dozens of No Kings protests across New Jersey Saturday, with immigration concerns top of mind.

item.title: With federal changes coming to Medicaid, NJ pursues ways to keep people enrolled
item.description: The Sherrill administration is preparing for federal changes coming to Medicaid that could result in hundreds of thousands of New Jerseyans losing coverage.

item.title: Double-digit increases predicted for NJ public worker health plans
item.description: Public worker health plans are expected to see more double-digit rate hikes amid stubbornly high utilization and more municipal departures.

item.title: TSA officers finally get paid amid ongoing Homeland Security shutdown
item.description: Most Transportation Security Administration officers received a paycheck Monday covering four weeks of back wages that were held up by the partial government shutdown.
